AGAINST elf-b22-003 THIS IS THE BATCH'S HIGHEST DEVICE OVERLAP - five of five shared - but the arcs align at only 2 consecutive moves, because elf-b22-003 folds its mechanism into its opening and runs one move ahead throughout: on strict ordinal alignment only move 3 (the relocation) matches; on the best offset, moves 2 and 3 match and move 4 breaks the run. THE r3 'ONLY MAJOR' IS DISCHARGED, AND THIS IS THE PAIR THE REPLACEMENT TRIGGER WAS WRITTEN TO STOP FIRING ON. Arc written off this prose: (1) the heel test - a phenomenon posed from the inside, a press, a lift, a listening, and the sound decides whether there is a journey; (2) the two-stage condition that makes crust, with two negative cases (rain gives a shell that shatters; an unbroken cold winter never wets the snow), which is why crust belongs to March and April; (3) the bearing window and what it cancels - out at four, over by ten, a load not home by ten lies till the next night, but in those hours neither ditches nor fences count and distances become straight lines; (4) what the surface excludes - the horse in the stable, calks and lighter loads refused, sledges by hand, skis to travel and not to haul - plus the counter-intuitive texture, rough and not slippery; (5) the year-to-year variance, the private decision made the evening before, the present in which the crust is merely beautiful, and the closing image of the runner tracks standing proud of the sinking snow. Against elf-b22-002 that aligns 5 of 5 at generic altitude, so the ARC leg of the trigger fires at its maximum - but the DEVICE leg does not fire at all. NEITHER unit carries a single device: no named investigator (Olivia Sjodin is a place-anchor, 'Olivia Sjodins lada', and speaks no word), no instrument, no study or survey, no demoted rival ACCOUNT, no remedy fitted at a measured point. The conjunction fails and this is not a major. What the two share is the generic personal-essay shape, which is a lane property rather than a convergence.

THE PAIR THE TRIGGER WAS DRAFTED FOR IS NOT CAUGHT EITHER, AND THAT IS A FINDING ABOUT THE TRIGGER. elf-b22-001 and elf-b22-003 share FIVE devices - named investigator, instrument, study, demoted rival account, remedy fitted at a measured point - which is the highest device overlap in batch22, and they align at only 2 consecutive moves, because elf-b22-003 folds its mechanism into its opening and runs one move ahead of elf-b22-001 throughout. The trigger correctly excludes the false positive and does not reach the true one.

ONE UNDISCLOSED CONVERGENCE, RECORDED FOR THE COORDINATOR RATHER THAN AGAINST THIS UNIT.
